RULES.f: If + present, will / be going to / can / may / might / should + verb
RULES.x: نستخدمه لشي ممكن يصير في الحاضر أو المستقبل. جملة if فيها مضارع بسيط (حتى لو نتكلم عن المستقبل)، والجملة الرئيسية فيها will أو فعل مساعد. إذا بدأنا بـ if نحط فاصلة.
ex: <mark>If</mark> the weather <mark>is</mark> nice, we <mark>will go</mark> to the beach.
إذا مطرت، يمكن الطرق تصير زلقة
You <mark>should</mark> call the police <mark>if</mark> you have an accident.
المفروض تتصل بالشرطة إذا صار لك حادث
m: If it will rain, we'll stay home.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
RULES.tip: لا تحط will بعد if. والفاصلة بس إذا جملة if جت أول.
q: If the weather ___ nice, we'll go to the beach.
If Sara is sick, we ___ bother her.
If it rains tonight, the roads ___ slippery.

If you ___ a red light, you might hit another car.
If Joe wants to go, he can come with us.
If Joe wants to go he, can come with us.
If Joe will want to go, he can come with us.
If, Joe wants to go he can come with us.
الفاصلة بعد جملة if، وما فيه will.
What ___ you do if it snows tomorrow?
السؤال: What will you do if…?
If Kate ___ a test tomorrow, she should study tonight.
I won't get a ticket if I ___ the law.
If you expect to go to France, you ___ learn French.

RULES.t: المضارع التام مع for و since
RULES.f: have / has + past participle + for (مدة) / since (بداية)
RULES.x: نستخدمه لشي بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمر للحين. for + مدة (ten years, two months)، و since + نقطة بداية (2001, Monday, I was a child). والسؤال: How long have you…?
m: I live here since 2010.
I have lived here since 2010.
RULES.tip: for ← مدة. since ← بداية. he / she / it ← has.

RULES.f: Have you ever + past participle? I have / I've never + past participle
RULES.x: نستخدمه لتجربة صارت في وقت ما في الماضي بدون ما نحدد متى. مع ever (قد؟) و never (أبدًا)، و before، و two times. إذا ذكرنا وقت محدد (yesterday, last year) نرجع للماضي البسيط.
m: I have seen that movie last week.
I saw that movie last week.
RULES.tip: وقت محدد (yesterday) ← ماضي بسيط. بدون وقت ← مضارع تام.

RULES.t: already / yet / still / no longer / anymore
RULES.e: Adverbs of time: already, yet, still, no longer, anymore, any longer
RULES.f: already (+) yet (− / ?) still (مستمر) no longer / not … anymore / not … any longer (وقف)
RULES.x: already = خلاص صار (مثبت، قبل التصريف الثالث). yet = للحين ما صار (نفي أو سؤال، آخر الجملة). still = ما زال مستمر. no longer = ما عاد (قبل الفعل). anymore / any longer = ما عاد (مع not، آخر الجملة).
ex: He <mark>no longer</mark> works here. = He <mark>doesn't</mark> work here <mark>anymore</mark>.
m: He doesn't no longer work here.
He no longer works here.
RULES.tip: no longer معناها نفي بنفسها، فلا تحط معها not.
q: The Hills ___ live in Denver. They moved last month.
قبل الفعل بدون not ← no longer.
Sam graduated last year. He isn't a student ___.
Ann isn't here. She's ___ gone home.
Al hasn't made up his mind ___.
Eric learned to drive, but he ___ doesn't have a license.
It rained yesterday, and it's ___ raining today.
Sgt Hill is a civilian now. He's ___ in the Army.

RULES.f: clause, so + result clause, or + choice clause, but + contrast clause, and + addition
RULES.x: so = عشان كذا (نتيجة). or = أو (اختيار). but = بس / لكن (عكس). and = و (إضافة). لما نربط جملتين كاملتين نحط فاصلة قبل أداة الربط.

Did he go<mark>, or</mark> did he stay?

I was tired, so I went to bed.

RULES.f: could / may / might + verb Could it be …? Where could he be?
RULES.x: نستخدم could و may و might عشان نخمّن لما ما نكون متأكدين. وكلمتين للتخمين بعد: maybe و perhaps، وتجي أول الجملة.

وش ممكن يكون هذا؟ يمكن صندوق

وين ممكن تكون آن؟ يمكن تتغدى

RULES.tip: maybe كلمة وحدة أول الجملة = perhaps. أما may be (كلمتين) فعل.

RULES.x: ‎-ed توصف إحساس الشخص: interested, excited, bored, confused, tired, frightened. و ‎-ing توصف الشي اللي يسبب الإحساس: interesting, exciting, boring, confusing, tiring, frightening.

RULES.x: إذا تنقل كلام أحد بـ said، نرجّع الفعل خطوة للماضي: want → wanted، is → was، am going → was going، don't → didn't. ونغيّر الضمائر: I → he / she، my → his / her.
ex: "I want to go to Europe." → He <mark>said</mark> he <mark>wanted</mark> to go to Europe.
"I need more sleep." → She <mark>said that</mark> she <mark>needed</mark> more sleep.

RULES.tip: What did he say? = وش قال؟ والجواب يبدأ: He said (that)…

3: We've Added On to the House

STORY: My name is Majed, and I've been in the military for twelve years. When I was a child, my family used to live in a small town near the mountains. Every winter, my father would take me hunting, and in summer we would go fishing at a quiet lake. I used to think that fishing was boring, but now I find it very relaxing. Last year I made an important decision about my future. I decided to take some courses at a university, so I could get a bachelor's degree. I haven't finished my degree yet, but I've already taken six courses. My wife said that she was very excited about it. We have also added on a den to our house in the suburbs, because we needed more room. If the weather is nice this weekend, we will have a get-together on the new patio. My brother can't come, so he might visit us next month.
